events.name: HackXetra: Hackathon
events.description: A 48-hour intense product development sprint hackathon under TechXetra, Tezpur University. Participating teams pick a real-world problem statement and build it into a production-grade working product. Evaluated purely on live product demonstration and market value without PPT presentations.
events.eligibility: Undergraduate students in India with valid student ID

registration.accommodation_notes: Charged separately for participants requiring on-campus stay/meals

tracks.name: Agentic Workflow
tracks.scope: Multi-step autonomous agents, task orchestration, AI-driven pipelines

tracks.name: Sustainability
tracks.scope: Carbon emission control, cost optimization, energy efficiency, resource/waste

rules: Team size must be 2-5 members; no member may belong to more than one team.
All code must be written during the 48-hour build sprint window.
AI tool usage (Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, v0, etc.) is fully permitted and encouraged; tools used must be noted in the project README.
Pre-built products are prohibited; commit history will be spot-checked.
Source code must be version-controlled and pushed to GitHub prior to the deadline.
No slide-deck (PPT) presentations allowed; evaluation is based strictly on live product demo and short pitch.
One problem statement per team with cap enforced per problem statement on a first-come basis.

evaluation_criteria.focus: Originality and novelty of the proposed solution
Code quality, architecture and depth of technical implementation
Stability, reliability and completeness of the working build
Practical relevance, scalability and commercial potential
Clarity, persuasiveness and confidence of live product pitch

prizes.notes: Top 3 teams receive direct incubation fast-track interviews.

timeline.activities: Check-in, Opening ceremony, Track problem release, 48-hour build sprint begins, Mentorship Round 1
Final GitHub push deadline, Live judging demos, Winner announcement

events.submitted_by: Shujan Mashuq Islam (B.Tech CS, 5th Sem, CSB24067)

events.name: Robo Race
events.description: Design and build a wired or wireless manually controlled robot capable of traversing complex terrains featuring sand pits, oil slicks, speed breakers, sharp hairpins, and elevated bridges in minimum time.
events.eligibility: Open to all students with valid college ID
rules: Maximum bot dimensions: 30cm x 30cm x 30cm at start.
Maximum bot weight: 5 kg (excluding controller and external power battery if wired).
Maximum onboard voltage: 24V DC.
Readymade toy car chassis are strictly prohibited; custom chassis required.
Each team gets 2 chances on the track; the lowest run time determines ranking.
Touching the bot during the race incurs a 10-second penalty per touch.

events.name: Robo Soccer
events.description: A high-octane 1v1 robotic football showdown where bots battle on an arena to shoot tennis balls into the opponent's goal post within 6 minutes.
rules: Bot size must fit within 30cm x 30cm x 30cm. Maximum weight 5 kg.
Match duration: Two halves of 3 minutes each with a 1-minute halftime break.
Bots may not grab, envelop, or hold the ball completely; dragging or pushing only.
Intentional destruction or entanglement of opponent's wires results in a red card disqualification.

events.name: Algo Maze
events.description: A fast-paced algorithmic coding race. Solve data structure and graph traversal pathfinding puzzles in C++, Python, or Java to navigate virtual autonomous agents through labyrinth challenges.
rules: Languages permitted: C, C++, Python 3, Java.
Standard competitive programming rules apply; plagiarism check enabled via MOSS.
2-hour sprint solving 5 algorithmic maze routing problems.
Tie-breaker based on least submission time with penalty minutes.

events.name: Circuitrix: Circuit Building
events.description: An online circuit design competition using LTspice where participants solve circuit design problems, optimize component values, and present simulation results alongside technical documentation.

event_format.name: Viva Voce
event_format.details: Conducted virtually or in person for shortlisted teams.

evaluation_criteria.focus: Component selection, topology, value optimization, simulation quality
Fulfillment of stated objectives in problem statement
Component labelling, schematic quality, video clarity

events.submitted_by: Akshay R. (Vice-Chairperson, IEEE Student Branch, Tezpur University)

events.name: Kinematic Model
events.description: Design and present physical or functional kinematic mechanisms (four-bar linkages, cam-followers, gear trains, Geneva mechanisms). Judged on transmission efficiency, degrees of freedom, and craftsmanship.
rules: Working physical prototype must be demonstrated to judges.
Fabrication using wood, acrylic, 3D printing, sheet metal, or PVC allowed.
Each team gets a 10-minute presentation slot including Q&A from the jury.

events.name: CAD Clash: AutoCAD
events.description: Replicate a physical building model in AutoCAD accurately to a given scale with maximum structural details within 3 hours.
events.device_requirement: Bring own laptops with AutoCAD pre-downloaded and initialized

structure_and_rules.initial_inspection: 15-minute window at start to analyze model, take measurements, and sketch rough layouts
structure_and_rules.drafting_access: Models kept on central tables for continuous verification
structure_and_rules.grace_period_and_penalty: Extra 30 minutes allowed with proportional deduction up to 20 marks

events.name: Constrolix: Bridge Construction
events.description: Construct a weight-bearing bridge measuring 50 cm in length using provided popsicle sticks and glue. The structure with the highest load-to-weight efficiency ratio wins.

duration_and_rules.grace_period_and_penalty: Additional 30 minutes allowed with proportional mark deduction up to max 20 marks

events.judging_criteria: Efficiency determined by calculating the ratio of maximum load taken by bridge to its self-weight.

events.name: Frontend Frenzy
events.tagline: Pixels, perfected under pressure. DESIGN FAST, BUILD SMART, ADAPT FASTER
events.description: A high-intensity web engineering sprint. Recreate a pixel-perfect modern responsive UI mockup under pressure, featuring an unannounced mid-challenge twist requirement.
events.eligibility: Open to registered students with valid institutional identity card

rounds.name: Screening Quiz
rounds.description: Web fundamentals, semantic markup, responsive design debugging.

rounds.name: Live Build
rounds.description: Rebuilding official design brief as a fully working styled webpage with surprise twist at 11:45 AM.

events.name: Sustainathon
events.description: A green technology problem-solving hackathon. Propose and prototype tech-driven solutions for renewable energy microgrids, carbon footprint reductions, and zero-emission campuses.
rules: Presentations must include lifecycle sustainability analysis and unit cost estimation.
Physical proof-of-concept or computer simulation required.

events.name: Waste Roulette: Waste Management Pitch
events.description: Teams spin the roulette to receive a random municipal or e-waste type (electronic circuit waste, bio-medical sludge, agricultural stubble) and have 90 minutes to design an upcycling economic product pitch.

events.name: Tic(k) on Board
events.description: Reinventing traditional board game mechanics. Participants compete in a design aptitude quiz followed by a physical prototype sprint to transform classic board games into novel interactive learning tools.

rounds.name: Design Aptitude Round
rounds.description: 30 aptitude questions referring to UCEED/CEED standards.

rounds.name: Creative Ability
rounds.description: Reimagining and redesigning a regular board game.

events.judge: Dr. Srinivasan G (Asst. Prof, Dept of Design)

events.name: TechXibition (School Level, Class 5-8)
events.description: Science and innovation model exhibition for junior school innovators. Showcasing working models in eco-friendly energy, simple machines, and everyday physics solutions.

events.name: TechXibition (School Level, Class 9-12)
events.description: Senior secondary school innovation showcase. Projects in robotics, renewable energy circuits, sensor-based automation, and digital technology.

events.name: TechXibition (UG Level)
events.description: National level undergraduate engineering project exposition. Final year engineering capstone projects, patented inventions, and working hardware prototypes.

events.name: Wrangle: Debate (Junior Level)
events.description: Conventional debate competition for school students (Classes 8 to 12) on ethical technology, social media impacts, and artificial intelligence in schools.

events.name: Wrangle: Debate (University Level)
events.description: Parliamentary debate showdown on geopolitics of semiconductor supply chains, autonomous defense systems, and digital sovereignty.

events.name: Full Force: Sci-Biz Quiz
events.description: A premier quiz exploring breakthroughs in physical sciences, deep tech startups, venture capital history, and global corporate patent battles.

events.name: Full Throttle: General Quiz
events.description: The flagship open general quiz covering world history, current affairs, sports legends, pop culture, and global geography.

events.name: Full Screen: MELA Quiz
events.description: Music, Entertainment, Literature, and Arts quiz. Celebrating classic cinema, anime, comic book universes, rock music lore, and modern television.

events.name: Full Frontier: India/NE Quiz
events.description: A quiz dedicated to the heritage, biodiversity, indigenous traditions, ethnic folklore, and modern milestones of Northeast India and the nation.

events.name: Poster Presentation (Research Based)
events.description: Peer-reviewed research poster presentation for scholars and students. Presenting original research in engineering, computer science, and applied mathematics.

events.name: Workshops (pre-TechXtra)
events.description: Certified hands-on technical workshop on Generative AI agent orchestration, edge computing, and real-time computer vision deployment.

prizes.notes: Verified participants receive certified participation credentials and course material.

events.name: Alumni / Invited Talks
events.description: Keynote addresses and fire-side chats featuring distinguished alumni leaders in tech, aerospace engineers, and venture capital investors.

events.name: Treasure Hunt
events.description: An adventurous campus-wide race solving cryptic cipher clues, geo-tagged QR codes, and logical puzzles hidden across historic university spots.

events.name: Inaugural Marathon
events.venue: University Main Gate to Sports Complex
events.description: 5-Kilometre morning fitness run flagging off TechXetra 2026. Promoting student wellness and green sustainability across campus.

events.name: GrandmasteriX: Chess
events.description: FIDE-rated Swiss-system rapid chess tournament. 6 intense rounds of tactical combat with digital clocks.
events.tournament_format: Open rapid tournament following Swiss system under standard FIDE guidelines.
events.time_control: 10 minutes + 2 seconds increment per move starting from move 1.
rules: Touch-Move Rule applies strictly.
Making an illegal move twice results in an immediate loss.
Silence required; any communication/distraction leads to immediate disqualification.
Tie-break match time control: 5 minutes + 2 seconds increment.
Arriving more than 10 minutes late results in forfeit.

events.name: Cubernetics: Rubik's Cube
events.description: WCA standard speedcubing showdown across 3x3 speedsolve and one-handed solve categories.
events.equipment: Cubes provided or participants may use personal cubes.

rounds.details: Single scramble solve; top participants advance.
3 tries with 3 different scrambles; top 4 by average time advance.

timing_rules.solving_time: Begins when timer released and stops when cube is fully solved.

events.name: ConXetra: Cosplay Convention
events.description: Grand anime, pop-culture, gaming, and superhero cosplay competition. Contestants bring characters to life with handmade gear, dynamic skits, and character walk-ons.
rules: 2-3 minutes stage runway and performance per participant.
No real weapons, pyrotechnics, or sharp metals allowed on stage.
Judged by external celebrity cosplay artists on costume fidelity, craft, and stage act.

events.name: 3-day Reel Making Competition
events.description: Cinematic visual storytelling competition. Capture the electric energy, concerts, robotic showdowns, and candid moments of TechXetra in a 60-second high-production Instagram Reel.
rules: Reel duration: 30 to 60 seconds (9:16 vertical aspect ratio).
All clips must be shot live during TechXetra 2026 on campus.
Final submission deadline: Day 3 at 3:00 PM.

breakdown.reward: Rs. 5,000 + Feature on official fest handle

events.name: Mystery Event: Automobile Exhibition
events.description: Exotic supercars, custom performance superbikes, rally vehicles, and electric formula student car exhibition by Northeast automotive clubs.

registration.fee_type: Free Entry for all gate pass holders

events.name: Museo Art Event
events.full_name: Museo Ceramic Trinket Tray Painting Experience
events.description: Hands-on creative workshop where participants paint, personalize, and take home their own handcrafted ceramic trinket tray, accompanied by relaxing indie music.

registration.fee_type: Per person (Includes ceramic tray & acrylic paint set)

events.name: FIFA 24
events.description: PlayStation 5 1v1 console soccer battle. 6-minute tactical clash of virtual football titans in a knockout bracket.
rules: Platform: PlayStation 5.
Match Half Length: 5 minutes.
Difficulty: Legendary; Game Speed: Normal.
Club teams only (International teams prohibited). Tactical defending mandatory.

events.name: Valorant
events.description: 5v5 competitive tactical shooter tournament on Mumbai servers. Coordinated execute plays, utility setups, and clutch fragging.
rules: Tournament Format: Single elimination knockout; Grand Finals are Best of 3 (BO3).
Map Pool: Ascent, Bind, Haven, Lotus, Split, Sunset, Abyss.
Cheating, scripting, or unauthorized third-party crosshairs will result in immediate squad ban.

events.name: BGMI
events.description: Battlegrounds Mobile India 4-player squad survival tournament. 4 custom lobby matches across Erangel and Miramar. Points calculated via official BGIS placement and kill ratios.
rules: Device: Mobile phones only. Emulators, iPads, triggers, and tablets are strictly banned.
Scoring System: Official 10-point BGIS placement table + 1 point per kill.
Room IDs and passwords distributed 15 minutes before match time.

events.name: Real Cricket
events.description: Real Cricket 24 1v1 mobile gaming faceoff. Fast 5-over quick matches testing shot timing, bowling field placements, and clutch death overs.

events.name: Illuminati: Motion Engineering
events.description: Night-time synchronized laser, drone, and projection mapping light show demonstrating advanced kinetic motion control and embedded microcontroller choreography.

registration.fee_type: Free Entry for all fest pass holders

events.name: Robot Show
events.description: Autonomous bipedal humanoid demonstrations, quadcopter drone swarms, and combat bot flame-spinner exhibitions.

registration.fee_type: Free Entry for all fest pass holders

events.name: Folk Dance (University Students)
events.description: Grand inter-college traditional folk dance extravaganza. Celebrating Assam's rich heritage including Bihu, Jhumur, Bagurumba, Sattriya, and traditional Northeast folk forms.
rules: Time limit: 8 to 12 minutes per performance.
Authentic traditional costumes and live or recorded folk instruments required.
Evaluated on choreography, synchronization, rhythm, and costume authenticity.

events.name: Folk Orchestra (University Students)
events.description: Ensemble performance using indigenous acoustic instruments: Dhol, Pepa, Gagana, Tokari, flute, and traditional percussion arrangements.

events.name: Tribute to Zubeen Garg (Drama)
events.description: Theatrical one-act drama and musical tribute celebrating the iconic music, lyrical impact, and social resonance of Assam's musical maestro Zubeen Garg.

events.name: Unplugged Session
events.description: Intimate acoustic vocal competition under the stars. Solo singers and duos performing acoustic ballads with acoustic guitar, cajon, or keyboard.

events.name: Mob Showdown
events.description: The mega street dance and flash mob showdown. Crews clash in high-energy hip-hop, locking, popping, and urban breaking routines.

events.name: Battle of Bands: Rock & Metal
events.description: The national flagship rock and metal battle. Top college and independent bands compete for the crown with thunderous guitar riffs, original compositions, and electrifying stage presence.
rules: Time slot: 20 minutes (including 5 minutes soundcheck).
Must perform at least one original composition and one cover song.
Full drum kit, monitors, and bass amp provided; personal guitars and pedals required.

breakdown.reward: Rs. 20,000 + Trophy + Opening slot for Pronite

events.name: Alumni Performance
events.description: Special musical and nostalgic performance by distinguished Tezpur University alumni artists welcoming delegates back to campus.

events.name: Creative Dance
events.description: Solo contemporary, lyrical, classical fusion, and thematic dance competition. Evaluated on emotional expression, technique, rhythm, and stage aesthetics.
